name: claude-md-dependency-rescan
tagline_zh: 项目依赖悄悄变了，CLAUDE.md 里的技术栈还停在过去？一键重扫比对，只读返回新增/移除/改名清单。
tagline_en: Dependencies changed but CLAUDE.md tech stack is stale? Rescan and diff, read-only, returns added/removed/renamed.
desc_en: Re-detect this project's tech stack from package.json / requirements.txt / pyproject.toml / go.mod / Cargo.toml and diff it against the Tech Stack section of every CLAUDE.md. Read-only — returns added / removed / renamed dependencies, never edits.
why_zh: 同类工具多只更新文档，它却先比对再报告，且只读不写，让 AI 上下文永远跟得上代码现实。
why_en: Unlike doc-updaters, it diffs first and reports only—read-only, so AI context stays true to code.
